vehicles.title: New 2026 Acura ADX Base 4D Sport Utility
vehicles.description: Discover the 2026 Acura ADX Base, a thoughtfully designed compact vehicle that delivers practical performance and modern convenience for today's drivers.- 1.5L Turbocharged Engine with 190 hp- CVT Automatic Transmission with Front-Wheel Drive- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS) active- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration- Power Moonroof- Heated Front Bucket Seats- Automatic Temperature Control with Dual Front Zone A/C- Exterior Parking Camera Rear- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control- Leather Steering Wheel and Shift Knob- Auto High-beam Headlights with Delay-Off Function- AcuraLink Emergency Communication System- 18" Aluminum Alloy Wheels- Speed-Sensing Steering- Four-Wheel Independent SuspensionThe ADX Base combines efficient everyday performance with an attractive silver exterior that complements its modern design. The 1.5L turbocharged engine produces 190 horsepower while maintaining excellent fuel efficiency at 27 city and 32 highway miles per gallon, making this vehicle an economical choice for both daily commutes and longer drives.Inside, you'll find a driver-focused cabin equipped with premium materials and intuitive controls. The heated front bucket seats in leatherette trim provide comfort throughout the year, while the power Moonroof adds an open-air element to your driving experience. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls and an AM/FM Acura Premium Audio System with eight speakers keep your favorite content within easy reach.Safety receives thoughtful attention with comprehensive airbag coverage including dual front, front side, knee, and overhead airbags. The Lane Keeping Assist System actively works to keep you centered in your lane, while the rear parking camera provides clear visibility when backing. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel disc ABS brakes form a protective foundation for confident driving.Technology integration is seamless with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, connecting your smartphone effortlessly to the vehicle's system. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror and automatic high-beam headlights enhance visibility, while the trip computer and outside temperature display keep useful information visible at a glance.We invite you to experience the 2026 Acura ADX Base firsthand. Visit our showroom today to explore how this vehicle's blend of efficiency, technology, and thoughtful design can become part of your daily driving life.

vehicles.title: New 2026 Acura ADX Base 4D Sport Utility
vehicles.description: The 2026 Acura ADX Base delivers a refined combination of performance and everyday practicality that makes it an intelligent choice for drivers seeking a versatile compact crossover.- 1.5L Turbocharged Engine with 190 Horsepower- CVT Transmission- Front-Wheel Drive- 27 City / 32 Highway MPG- Power Moonroof- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS)- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto Integration- Heated Front Bucket Seats- Acura Premium Audio System with 8 Speakers- Backup Camera with Parking Guidance- Dual Front Zone Automatic Climate Control- Electronic Stability Control with Traction Control- 18" Aluminum Alloy Wheels- Multiple Airbag System Including Knee and Overhead Airbags- Emergency Communication System (AcuraLink)This ADX combines thoughtful engineering with genuine comfort features. The turbocharged engine delivers responsive power for both city commutes and highway driving, while the continuously variable transmission ensures smooth acceleration without compromise. Fuel efficiency ratings of 27 MPG city and 32 MPG highway reflect the vehicle's balance between performance and economy.The interior welcomes you with heated front bucket seats and dual-zone climate control, allowing both driver and passenger to maintain their preferred temperature settings independently. The power Moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the Acura Premium Audio System with eight speakers delivers clear sound throughout the cabin. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keep your smartphone seamlessly integrated into your driving experience.Safety has been engineered into every aspect of this vehicle. The Lane Keeping Assist System actively helps maintain lane position, while Electronic Stability Control and traction control work continuously to manage grip on various road surfaces. The comprehensive airbag system includes front dual stage airbags, side impact protection, knee airbags, and overhead airbags. A backup camera provides visual guidance when reversing, and the AcuraLink emergency communication system offers peace of mind for connected drivers.The ADX's chassis features four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering that adapts to your driving conditions. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS braking provide confident stopping power. The 18-inch aluminum alloy wheels balance aesthetic appeal with practical durability, while speed-sensitive wipers automatically adjust their pace based on vehicle speed.Every detail has been considered for your daily convenience. The remote keyless entry system, power windows, power liftgate, and telescoping steering wheel all contribute to effortless operation. Inside, you'll find leather-appointed steering wheel and shift knob, heated door mirrors with power adjustment, and an auto-dimming rear-view mirror that reduces glare from following traffic.We invite you to experience the 2026 Acura ADX Base firsthand. This vehicle represents genuine value for discerning drivers who appreciate quality engineering and thoughtful design.

vehicles.title: New 2026 Acura MDX Technology Package
vehicles.description: The 2026 Acura MDX Technology Package in Blue delivers a sophisticated blend of performance, comfort, and advanced technology designed for families and professionals who demand excellence in their three-row SUV.- 19-speaker Bang & Olufsen Premium Audio System- Google Built-in Navigation with 3-Years Unlimited Data Plan- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS)- Power liftgate with auto tilt-away steering wheel- Heated front sport seats with perforated premium Milano leather trim- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C- Power Moonroof- Electronic stability control and traction control- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering- Auto high-beam headlights with delay-off feature- Rear camera parking assistance- HomeLink garage door transmitter- 20-inch aluminum alloy wheels- Rain-sensing wipers with speed-sensitive adjustmentThe MDX Technology Package positions itself as a leader in the three-row segment by combining everyday practicality with refined performance. The 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC 24V engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive delivers responsive handling while achieving 19 city and 26 highway mpg. This powertrain balances efficiency with the capability needed for both daily commutes and weekend adventures.Interior comfort extends across all three rows, with heated front sport seats upholstered in perforated premium Milano leather and a rear seat center armrest for added convenience. Memory settings for both the driver seat and steering wheel ensure personalized comfort for regular drivers, while automatic temperature control maintains ideal climate conditions throughout the cabin.Safety and driver assistance features work together to provide confidence on every journey. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension deliver composed handling, while lane keeping assist and rear parking camera add modern convenience. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags provide comprehensive occupant protection. The emergency communication system through AcuraLink offers added peace of mind.Technology integration makes this MDX a connected vehicle experience. Google Built-in navigation with three years of unlimited data for in-vehicle apps keeps you informed and on course, while the 19-speaker Bang & Olufsen audio system transforms every drive into an audio showcase. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto seamlessly integrate your smartphone, providing access to your preferred navigation, messaging, and entertainment apps.Exterior design combines functional features with refined styling. The 20-inch aluminum alloy wheels, body-color bumpers, and heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators contribute to both aesthetics and usability. The power Moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while rain-sensing wipers and a rear window wiper ensure clear visibility in all conditions.We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the 2026 Acura MDX Technology Package firsthand and discover how its thoughtful engineering and premium appointments enhance both your daily driving and longer journeys.

vehicles.title: New 2026 Acura MDX Technology Package
vehicles.description: Discover the 2026 Acura MDX Technology Package, a three-row luxury SUV that combines refined craftsmanship with intelligent engineering to meet the demands of today's discerning driver.This MDX arrives equipped with a comprehensive suite of premium features designed to enhance every journey:- 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC engine with 10-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive- Bang & Olufsen Premium Audio System with 19 speakers- Google built-in navigation with three years of unlimited data plan for in-vehicle apps- Perforated premium Milano leather-trimmed heated front sport seats with power adjustment and memory settings- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS) active safety technology- Automatic high-beam headlights with delay-off functionality- Power moonroof with auto tilt-away steering wheel- 20-inch aluminum alloy wheels- Rear parking camera with exterior view- Three-row seating configuration with split-folding rear seat and third-row bench option- HomeLink garage door transmitter integration- Dual-zone front climate control with rear air conditioning- Electronic stability control with traction control and brake assistThe MDX delivers practical versatility without sacrificing comfort or style. The three-row layout accommodates up to seven passengers, while the split-folding rear seats provide flexible cargo space for everything from groceries to sporting equipment. The 10-speed automatic transmission works seamlessly with the 3.5L V6 engine to achieve city fuel economy of 19 MPG and highway efficiency of 26 MPG, balancing performance with responsible consumption.Inside, you'll find the hallmarks of Acura's commitment to driver-focused design. The perforated Milano leather seats offer support during your daily commute, while heated functionality adds welcome comfort during winter months. The memory seat and steering wheel settings personalize your driving experience, automatically adjusting to your preferences each time you enter the vehicle. Dual-zone automatic temperature control ensures both driver and passenger comfort, complemented by rear air conditioning for rear-seat passengers.Technology integration in this MDX puts control at your fingertips. The Google built-in navigation system guides you with familiar functionality and receives three years of unlimited data, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keeps your smartphone seamlessly integrated. The 19-speaker Bang & Olufsen Premium Audio System transforms every drive into an audio experience, with steering wheel controls allowing safe adjustment without taking your eyes off the road.Safety receives equal priority in this MDX. The Lane Keeping Assist System actively helps maintain your lane position, while automatic high-beam headlights adjust to traffic conditions. Multiple airbags, including front and side impact protection, work alongside electronic stability control and traction control systems. The rear parking camera provides visual guidance during reversing, and the emergency communication system offers additional peace of mind.The 2026 Acura MDX Technology Package arrives in striking black with 20-inch aluminum alloy wheels, power moonroof, and dual-zone climate control. This is a vehicle engineered for those who value quality, technology, and the freedom to move with purpose and confidence. Schedule a visit to see and experience this MDX firsthand.

vehicles.title: New 2026 Acura MDX Advance Package and Navigation
vehicles.description: This 2026 Acura MDX Advance Package delivers sophisticated performance and refined comfort for families who demand capability without compromise.- 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC 24V engine with 10-Speed Automatic transmission- Premium Bang & Olufsen audio system with 19 speakers- Google built-in navigation with 3-Years Unlimited Data Plan- Heated and ventilated front sport seats with premium Milano leather- Power Moonroof- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS) with adaptive suspension- Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning- SH-AWD (Super Handling All-Wheel Drive)- Heads-Up Display- 20" aluminum alloy wheels- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration- AcuraLink emergency communication system- Auto high-beam headlights with fog lights- Three-row seating with split-folding rear seatThe MDX Advance Package seats seven passengers across three rows, with real flexibility built into its design. The third-row split-bench seat folds to accommodate cargo, while the power passenger seat and split folding rear seat allow you to customize the interior for your needs. Those who travel frequently will appreciate how the spacious cabin combines genuine comfort with thoughtful storage solutions.Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily drive. Google built-in navigation provides three years of unlimited data for in-vehicle apps, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep your smartphone connected. The Heads-Up Display projects critical information onto the windshield, minimizing distractions during your commute. HomeLink garage door transmitter coordination means your garage opens as you approach home.Safety systems work proactively to protect your family. Lane Keeping Assist System helps maintain proper lane positioning, while electronic stability control and traction management keep all four wheels working together. The vehicle includes dual airbags, side-impact protection, and knee airbags positioned strategically throughout the cabin. Exterior parking camera and low tire pressure monitoring add practical awareness during everyday driving.The SH-AWD system delivers confident handling through all seasons. Independent four-wheel suspension paired with speed-sensing steering adapts to road conditions, while the adaptive suspension adjusts to your driving style. The 3.5L V6 achieves 19 city and 25 highway mpg, balancing power with reasonable fuel consumption for a seven-passenger luxury SUV.Comfort touches distinguish this Advance Package throughout. Heated and ventilated front sport seats maintain your preferred temperature, while the heated steering wheel ensures comfortable grip during cold mornings. The power driver seat with memory function and auto tilt-away steering wheel simplify entry and exit. Dual-zone climate control lets front passengers set independent temperatures while the rear air conditioning keeps back-seat occupants comfortable.This Platinum White Pearl 2026 Acura MDX Advance Package SH-AWD represents a thoughtful choice for buyers seeking three-row capacity, refined materials, and genuine technological integration. Visit our showroom to experience the combination of space, performance, and luxury firsthand.

vehicles.description: The 2026 Acura MDX Type S with Advance Package SH-AWD delivers a refined three-row luxury experience designed for families who refuse to compromise on performance and sophistication.- Bang and Olufsen Ultra Sound System- Google Built-in Navigation with 3-Years Unlimited Data Plan- Heated and Ventilated Front Sport Seats with Heated Steering Wheel- Super Handling All-Wheel Drive (SH-AWD)- Heads-Up Display- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS)- Adaptive Suspension with Auto-Leveling- Power Moonroof- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto Integration- 21" Aluminum Alloy Wheels- Premium Milano Leather and Ultrasuede Seating- Three-Row Seating with Split-Folding Rear Seat- Four-Wheel Independent Suspension- Dual Front Zone Automatic Climate Control- Emergency Communication System (AcuraLink)This Type S model stands out with its 3.0L V6 engine paired to a 10-speed automatic transmission, offering a balanced approach to power and efficiency. The SH-AWD system actively manages traction across varying road conditions, while the adaptive suspension automatically adjusts to provide both responsive handling and composed rides. You'll appreciate the premium Milano leather and Ultrasuede appointments throughout the cabin, along with heated and ventilated front sport seats that make every journey comfortable regardless of season.Entertainment and connectivity take center stage with the Bang and Olufsen Ultra Sound System delivering studio-quality audio, while Google's built-in navigation system comes preloaded with three years of unlimited data for in-vehicle apps. The Heads-Up Display projects vital information directly into your line of sight, reducing distractions while keeping you informed. Integration with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto ensures your smartphone connects seamlessly to the vehicle's ecosystem.Safety has been thoroughly addressed with dual front airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags working in concert with Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and the Lane Keeping Assist System. The anti-whiplash design of front head restraints adds another layer of protection for occupants at all seating positions.The exterior White finish complements the Type S aesthetic, complemented by 21-inch aluminum alloy wheels and a power Moonroof that invites natural light into the spacious cabin. The power liftgate provides convenient hands-free access to the cargo area, while rain-sensing wipers and auto high-beam headlights handle changing weather conditions automatically.With seating for up to seven passengers across three rows, the MDX Type S maximizes versatility without sacrificing the luxury appointments you expect from the Acura brand. Split-folding rear seats expand cargo flexibility, accommodating everything from groceries to gear while maintaining passenger comfort.This 2026 MDX Type S represents the intersection of premium materials, advanced technology, and thoughtful engineering—a vehicle built for those who appreciate both destination and journey.

The premium Milano Leather and Ultrasuede interior, along with heated and ventilated front seats, creates a refined driving environment that welcomes both driver and passengers. Heated rear seats extend comfort throughout the cabin, while the power Moonroof adds an open-air dimension to your driving experience.Technology plays a central role in this vehicle's appeal. The Google built-in navigation system comes equipped with three years of unlimited data for in-vehicle apps, ensuring you stay connected and informed. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility keep your smartphone seamlessly integrated, while the Bang and Olufsen Ultra Sound System delivers an elevated audio experience for every journey.Safety and handling refinement distinguish the MDX Type S in its segment. The Lane Keeping Assist System works actively to maintain your position in traffic, while adaptive suspension with auto-leveling technology adjusts to road conditions in real time. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system provide confidence in diverse driving situations. The SH-AWD system enhances both traction and cornering stability, making this vehicle responsive whether navigating city streets or highway curves.This gray exterior paired with premium interior materials and extensive feature content presents a vehicle ready to serve multiple roles in your life—from business commutes to weekend adventures. The combination of comfort appointments, advanced safety systems, and refined engineering reflects Acura's commitment to delivering vehicles that work as hard as you do.We invite you to experience this MDX Type S firsthand. Visit our showroom to sit behind the wheel and discover how this vehicle's blend of luxury, performance, and practicality aligns with your expectations for premium transportation.

The MDX delivers 19 MPG in city driving and 26 MPG on the highway, providing reasonable efficiency for a three-row SUV of this caliber. The 10-speed automatic transmission works in harmony with the V6 engine to balance performance with economy, ensuring your driving costs remain manageable across various conditions.This 2026 Acura MDX Base represents a thoughtful investment in family transportation. With its comprehensive Acura Precision Certification and genuine peace of mind from extended powertrain protection, you can drive forward knowing your investment is properly safeguarded.
